description: The LOGICAL NOT of an abbreviated relation in an abbreviated combined relation condition - NOT followed by a word other than GREATER, >, LESS, <, EQUAL or = (A > B AND NOT >= C OR D is ((A > B) AND (NOT (A >= C))) OR (A >= D)), §1985:VI.6.3.3 GRL2.1/GRL2.2. ISO 2002 prohibited NOT before the relational operators meaning 'greater than or equal to' and 'less than or equal to' (§2002:F.1 item 22), and the 2014 and 2023 general formats admit NOT there only as part of a relational operator or before object-1 (§2023:8.8.4.12.2; §2023:8.8.4.12.4 GR1 NOTE: NOT cannot immediately precede an extended-relational operator). Accepted at 85; COBOL0902 from 2002 (a warning under --permissive, the 85 meaning kept). One grammar node, negatedAbbreviatedRelation (kb/Work PB5123).
display: a logical NOT before the relational operator of an abbreviated relation
citation: §1985:VI.6.3.3 GRL2.2; §2002:F.1 item 22 (NOT prohibited before >= and <= in an abbreviated combined relation condition); §2023:8.8.4.12.2

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMANOT.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 A PIC 9 VALUE 5.
01 B PIC 9 VALUE 1.
01 C PIC 9 VALUE 6.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    IF A > B AND NOT >= C
        DISPLAY "TRUE"
    END-IF.
    STOP RUN.
